{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

dd = open('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/data_dictionary.md', 'r').read()

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Remove sentinel values (-999) from biomarker_baseline
# Replace -999 with NaN for analysis
trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline_clean'] = trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check the response rate by arm
response_by_arm = trial_df_deduped.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print('Response rate by arm:')
print(response_by_arm)

# Check baseline severity imbalance
severity_by_arm = trial_df_deduped.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print('\nBaseline severity by arm:')
print(severity_by_arm)

# Compute change in biomarker for each patient
trial_df_deduped['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_deduped['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline_clean']

# Compute average change by arm
avg_change_by_arm = trial_df_deduped.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print('\nAverage biomarker change by arm:')
print(avg_change_by_arm)

# Check average biomarker change for treatment vs control
print('\nAverage biomarker change, treatment:', trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped["arm"] == "treatment"]["biomarker_change"].mean())
print('Average biomarker change, control:', trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped["arm"] == "control"]["biomarker_change"].mean())

# Check if the treatment arm had higher baseline biomarker (which may explain the change)
print('\nAverage baseline biomarker (cleaned) by arm:')
print(trial_df_deduped.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline_clean'].mean())"}
